title: a census household decided
line: the four the page names and cites each get a card and the rule takes none on a tree with no accepted fact; the son's accept writes his facts and an alias, the mother's the mother-son link, the father's the couple; the accepted birthplace against the file's claim is a conflict question, never an overwrite; the birth record's father is one letter apart and the mother's surname garbled, both cards for the owner; the sister is taken by the rule through the claimed sibling and placed undecided; a link on the owner's word is a vouch, no link for the matcher

steps.say: the 1940 page arrives through the inbox

the rule stands on accepted facts only, and the son has none

the vouch counts as ground with nothing excluded
the vouch still counts as ground when an unrelated proposal's assertions are excluded: it has no proposal key to match
